walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Economics specification.

Introduction to Economics appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Introduction to Economics in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Introduction to Economics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
